records.claim: For a Japan Student status application, applicants may be asked to provide evidence that they can cover study-period expenses; the official Study in Japan guidance lists a sponsor savings-balance certificate, prior-year income certificate and documentation identifying the source of funds as examples of financial evidence.
records.sourceAuthority: Study in Japan / Japan Student Services Organization
records.methodology: Direct review of current official Study in Japan immigration-procedures guidance; recorded as a documentary evidence requirement rather than a fixed universal yen threshold.

records.claim: For international students, an authorised Certificate of Eligibility is generally applied for at a regional immigration services bureau in Japan by the student or a proxy such as the accepting school; after the COE is issued, the applicant can submit the visa application to a Japanese embassy or consulate.
records.sourceAuthority: Study in Japan / Japan Student Services Organization
records.methodology: Direct review of current official Study in Japan immigration-procedures guidance.

records.claim: Under Japan's Engineer/Specialist in Humanities/International Services status criteria, remuneration must be equal to or greater than the remuneration a Japanese national would receive for the same work; this is a pay-parity condition, not a single universal published salary threshold.
records.methodology: Direct review of the Immigration Services Agency's current Engineer/Specialist in Humanities/International Services status and application guidance, with the remuneration criterion recorded without inventing a numeric salary floor.

records.claim: Japan provides a dedicated Immigration Services Agency application route for Engineer/Specialist in Humanities/International Services, with required documents varying by employer category and application type; the agency lists certificate-of-eligibility and residence-status procedures for this status.
records.methodology: Direct review of the current Immigration Services Agency status-specific application page and its document requirements.
